responsibility: Defines the PowerPC auxiliary-vector and thread-control-block constants used by rs6000 CPU capability builtins and runtime probes. It records the AT_PLATFORM, AT_HWCAP, and AT_HWCAP2 bit assignments and the glibc TCB offsets for those values, letting backend code such as cpu_is/cpu_supports builtin expansion reason about Linux PowerPC platform generation and ISA feature availability without hardcoding magic numbers elsewhere.
